```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))

has_terra <- requireNamespace("terra", quietly = TRUE)
```

## Charger les clusters

```{r}
clusters <- read.csv("data/processed/clusters_gps.csv")
cat("Nombre de clusters :", nrow(clusters), "\n")

patch_dir <- "data/processed/patches_landsat"
n_patches <- length(list.files(patch_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$"))
cat("Patches disponibles :", n_patches, "/", nrow(clusters), "\n")
```

---

## Afficher un patch au hasard

```{r random-patch, fig.height=5, fig.width=5, eval=has_terra}
library(terra)

set.seed(42)
idx <- sample(nrow(clusters), 1)
cid <- clusters$cluster[idx]
wealth <- round(clusters$wealth_mean[idx], 3)

patch_file <- file.path(patch_dir, paste0("cluster_", sprintf("%03d", cid), ".tif"))

if (file.exists(patch_file)) {
  r <- rast(patch_file)
  
  # terra retourne deja (H, W, C)
  rgb <- as.array(r)
  
  # Normaliser pour l'affichage
  rgb <- (rgb - min(rgb)) / (max(rgb) - min(rgb))
  
  par(mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1))
  plot(as.raster(rgb))
  title(main = paste0("Cluster ", cid, " | Richesse = ", wealth))
} else {
  cat("Patch non trouvé pour le cluster", cid, "\n")
}
```

```{r no-terra-fallback, eval=!has_terra}
cat("Paquet 'terra' non disponible.\n")
cat("Installer avec : install.packages('terra')\n")
```

## Comparer clusters riches vs pauvres

```{r rich-vs-poor, fig.height=8, fig.width=6, eval=has_terra}
library(terra)

cluster_wealth <- read.csv("data/processed/clusters_gps.csv")

top_poor <- head(cluster_wealth$cluster[order(cluster_wealth$wealth_mean)], 3)
top_rich <- tail(cluster_wealth$cluster[order(cluster_wealth$wealth_mean)], 3)

read_patch <- function(cid) {
  f <- file.path(patch_dir, paste0("cluster_", sprintf("%03d", cid), ".tif"))
  if (file.exists(f)) {
    r <- rast(f)
    # terra retourne deja (H, W, C)
    rgb <- as.array(r)
    rgb[is.na(rgb)] <- 0
    # Normaliser pour l'affichage
    rgb <- (rgb - min(rgb)) / (max(rgb) - min(rgb) + 1e-8)
    return(rgb)
  }
  NULL
}

par(mfrow = c(2, 3), mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1))

for (cid in top_poor) {
  wealth <- cluster_wealth$wealth_mean[cluster_wealth$cluster == cid]
  p <- read_patch(cid)
  if (!is.null(p)) {
    plot(as.raster(p))
    title(main = paste0("PAUVRE : Cluster ", cid, " (", round(wealth, 2), ")"))
  }
}
for (cid in top_rich) {
  wealth <- cluster_wealth$wealth_mean[cluster_wealth$cluster == cid]
  p <- read_patch(cid)
  if (!is.null(p)) {
    plot(as.raster(p))
    title(main = paste0("RICHE : Cluster ", cid, " (", round(wealth, 2), ")"))
  }
}
```

## Verification : distribution spatiale des clusters avec/sans patch

```{r spatial-check}
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

gps <- st_read("data/raw/NIGE61FL.shp", quiet = TRUE)

gps <- gps %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = as.integer(DHSCLUST),
    patch_present = file.exists(
      file.path(patch_dir, paste0("cluster_", sprintf("%03d", cluster), ".tif"))
    )
  )

cat("Clusters avec patch :", sum(gps$patch_present), "/", nrow(gps), "\n")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = gps, aes(color = patch_present), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "#2ca02c", "FALSE" = "#d62728"),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "Patch dispo", "FALSE" = "Patch manquant"),
    name = "Statut"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Couverture des patches Landsat 7",
    x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

## Stats descriptives des clusters avec patch

```{r stats}
if (n_patches > 0) {
  cluster_wealth <- read.csv("data/processed/clusters_gps.csv")
  cluster_wealth$has_patch <- file.exists(
    file.path(patch_dir, paste0("cluster_", sprintf("%03d", cluster_wealth$cluster), ".tif"))
  )
  
  with_patch <- cluster_wealth %>% filter(has_patch)
  without_patch <- cluster_wealth %>% filter(!has_patch)
  
  cat("Avec patch  :", nrow(with_patch), "clusters,",
      "richesse moyenne =", round(mean(with_patch$wealth_mean), 2), "\n")
  cat("Sans patch  :", nrow(without_patch), "clusters,",
      "richesse moyenne =", round(mean(without_patch$wealth_mean), 2), "\n")
}
```
